label: Topic
explain: Marks what the sentence is about. Usually goes first, but it is not wrong elsewhere. Think of it as pointing at the thing you want to talk about.
examples: わたし.は がくせいです。|I'm a student.
おちゃ.は たかいです。|The tea is expensive.

label: Doer
explain: Marks who does the action or what exists. Use it when the doer is new information or the answer to 'who?' / 'what?'.
examples: あめ.が ふります。|It's raining.
じかん.が あります。|I have time.

label: Target
explain: Marks the object of the action: what you eat, buy, read, see. Also the place you move through or leave.
examples: おちゃ.を のみます。|I drink tea.
いえ.を でます。|I leave home.

label: Goal / To
short: Destination, receiver, point in time, place where something is
explain: Marks the arrival point: where you go, who receives, when (clock time / day), and where something is or lives.
examples: なら.に いきます。|I'll go to Nara.
さんじ.に あいます。|We'll meet at three.

label: Place / By
short: Where the action happens, or the tool/means
explain: Marks the place where an action takes place (not where something merely is), and the means: by bus, with chopsticks, in Japanese.
examples: みせ.で かいます。|I buy it at the shop.
バス.で いきます。|I'll go by bus.

label: With / And
explain: Marks the person you do something with, and joins two nouns. Also marks what is said or thought.
examples: ともだち.と いきます。|I'll go with a friend.
おちゃとおかし.を ください。|Tea and sweets, please.

label: Toward
explain: Marks the direction you head toward. Very close to に for destinations; へ stresses the direction, に the arrival. Either is fine in daily talk.
examples: とうきょう.へ いきます。|I'll head to Tokyo.

label: From
short: Starting point in place or time
explain: Marks where or when something starts: from Nara, from nine o'clock, from a friend.
examples: なら.から きます。|I'm coming from Nara.
くじ.から はたらきます。|I work from nine.

label: Until / Up to
short: End point in place or time
explain: Marks where or when something ends: until five, up to the station. Often pairs with から.
examples: ごじ.まで はたらきます。|I work until five.
えき.まで あるきます。|I'll walk to the station.

label: Also
explain: Adds 'also'. It replaces は, が, を and is added after に, で, と, へ, から, まで.
examples: わたし.も いきます。|I'm going too.
なら.でも かいます。|I buy it in Nara too.
